findings.summary: Tenant history rows are clickable under the wrong permission
findings.details: The tenant history page is route-gated by action.redemption.view_all_history, then uses that same permission to enable row clicks and mount TransactionDetailSheet. That sheet fetches /redemption/requests/{id}, whose contract (redemption-history.yaml:487-500, x-permission: action.redemption.view_history) requires action.redemption.view_history, not view_all_history. A client admin with tenant-history permission only sees clickable rows but every detail read can 403, breaking the all-tenant audit workflow at the detail step. VERIFIED against contract.
findings.recommendation: Gate the detail sheet with the permission required by the detail endpoint (action.redemption.view_history), or add/use an admin detail endpoint authorized by action.redemption.view_all_history.
findings.scopeNote: Pre-existing in the redemption-history feature (inherited from roadmaps/redemption-store base) — NOT introduced by reward-balance-expiration. Surfaced because Codex diffs against main.

adversarial-review.codexOutput:
# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against main
Verdict: needs-attention

Do not ship: the diff still has permission-gating mismatches that break protected redemption history flows, plus a date validation gap in expiration policy setup.

Findings:
- [high] Tenant history rows are clickable under the wrong permission (src/pages/redemption-history/TenantTransactionHistoryPage.tsx:200-203)
  The tenant history page is route-gated by action.redemption.view_all_history, then uses that same permission to enable row clicks and mount TransactionDetailSheet. That sheet fetches /redemption/requests/{id}, whose contract requires action.redemption.view_history, not view_all_history. A client admin with tenant-history permission only will see clickable rows but every detail read can 403, making the all-tenant audit workflow fail at the detail step.
  Recommendation: Gate the detail sheet with the permission required by the detail endpoint, or add/use an admin detail endpoint authorized by action.redemption.view_all_history.
- [medium] Personal history route bypasses the history permission gate (src/App.tsx:202-207)
  The /redemption/history route is nested under only module.redemption_store, but the page immediately calls personal/company history APIs that require action.redemption.view_history. Users with store access but without history permission can directly navigate to the page and trigger unauthorized reads and error states that the sidebar correctly hides.
  Recommendation: Move /redemption/history under a ProtectedRoute for action.redemption.view_history, separate from the store and confirmation routes.
- [medium] Fixed-date validation can accept a non-future expiry date (src/components/balanceExpiration/balanceExpirationPolicySchema.ts:73-76)
  The schema validates a YYYY-MM-DD form value with new Date(data.fixedExpiryDate), which parses the date as UTC midnight. In positive-offset timezones, selecting today's date compares later than local midnight and can pass the “future date” check, despite the contract requiring a strictly future tenant date. That lets the form submit an invalid policy and rely on backend rejection.
  Recommendation: Parse date-only values from local calendar parts and reject dates <= local today; also set the date input minimum to tomorrow, not today.

Next steps:
- Fix the permission gates and add regression tests for users with view_all_history-only and module.redemption_store-only permission sets.
- Add a timezone-safe fixed-date validation test for selecting today's date in a positive UTC offset.
